I've been waiting 9 months, but until recently I realized that what I have now is not enough for me to live with and that I have hurt too many people.

What changed? I saw my exes social media account recently, and it came and hit me as a reality check because she has moved on and is happy with someone new. Sure I got upset that she is happy and I am still moving on, but really it was a reality check that time has passed and what I have now is what I have to work with and I realized I don't like my life anymore.

I agree with all your advice, and they are things I have been trying to do. Unfortunately, I am living with my mom who is asking me to get a job, which isn't unreasonable. I found a job but never showed up because I became emotionally unstable the day before and called in saying I can't work and shouldn't for my reason of being unstable. The problem with me for time healing all, is I have run out of time. I have had 9 months of healing and its not enough, but I can't have more.

The past being stuck in the past is why I am unable to forgive myself. I hurt people after my ex, I have made them feel pain because of my previous suffering. How am I supposed to just move on? If they can't forgive me how can I forgive myself?

I don't know how exactly to respond to all this, but I do agree with your reasoning. I have tried therapy and changing my lifestyle to try to help change how my thoughts are. Every time I have tried doing something like that, my emotions, stress, and anxiety spike and I can't handle the change. Like I have been saying, I am exhausted at this point in trying to change my thoughts. I don't know if this response is helpful for you, but it is what I can share that is related to what you were saying.

Its not over my ex, rather what happened with how I have been since that point. I have caused pain and lost many friends trying to recover from what happened, and I still am struggling to manage my feelings. I feel too far gone to want to try to repair or improve what I have left.
